@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My grandmother shared her secret apple pie r______e with me. She suggested following the step-by-step guide exactly.
= recipe
~詞義 recipe（n.）食譜
~原文 My grandmother shared her secret apple pie recipe with me. She suggested following the step-by-step guide exactly.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The movie's plot was so c______d that Lucy couldn't understand it.
= complicated
~詞義 complicated（adj.）複雜的
~原文 The movie's plot was so complicated that Lucy couldn't understand it.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: When the priest asked if there was any o______n, no one raised a hand, so the couple went on to get married.
= objection
~詞義 objection（n.）異議
~原文 When the priest asked if there was any objection, no one raised a hand, so the couple went on to get married.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Hikers remained on the a______t for sudden weather changes, knowing a fast-moving storm could trap them on the mountain trail.
= alert
~詞義 alert（n.）對…提防(on the alert for…)
~原文 Hikers remained on the alert for sudden weather changes, knowing a fast-moving storm could trap them on the mountain trail.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Due to the typhoon, there was a delay in the d______e of the flight; the flight would take off a few hours later.
= departure
~詞義 departure（n.）出發
~原文 Due to the typhoon, there was a delay in the departure of the flight; the flight would take off a few hours later.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Jason is a(n) ______ latecomer, so he often misses the first lesson of the morning.
A: aggressive
B: habitual
C: favorable
D: delicate
= B
~詞義 habitual（adj.）習慣性的
~原文 Jason is a(n) habitual latecomer, so he often misses the first lesson of the morning.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After many hours of being questioned, the suspect finally confessed to ______ the crime.
A: analyzing
B: invading
C: committing
D: departing
= C
~詞義 commit（v.）犯(罪)
~原文 After many hours of being questioned, the suspect finally confessed to committing the crime.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Many people can't ______ fact from opinion when reading posts on social media.
A: immigrate
B: distinguish
C: concentrate
D: sacrifice
= B
~詞義 distinguish（v.）分辨
~原文 Many people can't distinguish fact from opinion when reading posts on social media.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: William is a successful tennis player, but he has ______ most of his free time in order to achieve this success.
A: alerted
B: sacrificed
C: emerged
D: fetched
= B
~詞義 sacrifice（v.）犧牲
~原文 William is a successful tennis player, but he has sacrificed most of his free time in order to achieve this success.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The characters in this animated film look so ______ that many viewers almost believe they are real actors.
A: manual
B: favorable
C: amusing
D: realistic
= D
~詞義 realistic（adj.）逼真的
~原文 The characters in this animated film look so realistic that many viewers almost believe they are real actors.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: implies
B: concepts
C: install
D: disability
E: immigrants
F: fame

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The plumber will come to ______ the new dishwasher in the kitchen tomorrow.
= C
~詞義 install（v.）安裝
~原文 The plumber will come to install the new dishwasher in the kitchen tomorrow.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Britney first rose to ______ as a singer when she was seventeen years old.
= F
~詞義 fame（n.）名氣
~原文 Britney first rose to fame as a singer when she was seventeen years old.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: As the new study ______, humans are almost totally responsible for global warming.
= A
~詞義 imply（v.）暗示;意味著
~原文 As the new study implies, humans are almost totally responsible for global warming.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: In mathematics, it is more important to understand ______ than to memorize formulae.
= B
~詞義 concept（n.）概念
~原文 In mathematics, it is more important to understand concepts than to memorize formulae.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Fanny refused to let her ______ stop her from pursuing her dream.
= D
~詞義 disability（n.）殘疾
~原文 Fanny refused to let her disability stop her from pursuing her dream.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: peers
B: protested
C: recall
D: satellites
E: seize
F: gender

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: After Andy's parents told him that he was grounded, he ______ the decision by refusing to talk to them.
= B
~詞義 protest（v.）抗議
~原文 After Andy's parents told him that he was grounded, he protested the decision by refusing to talk to them.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many teenagers feel pressure to fit in with their ______, especially when facing new academic or social challenges in school.
= A
~詞義 peer（n.）同僚
~原文 Many teenagers feel pressure to fit in with their peers, especially when facing new academic or social challenges in school.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Judy wanted to write a postcard to Sam, but she couldn't ______ his address, so she wrote him an email instead.
= C
~詞義 recall（v.）憶起
~原文 Judy wanted to write a postcard to Sam, but she couldn't recall his address, so she wrote him an email instead.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. and Mrs. White value ______ equality, so they try to treat their son and daughter in exactly the same way.
= F
~詞義 gender（n.）性別
~原文 Mr. and Mrs. White value gender equality, so they try to treat their son and daughter in exactly the same way.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: After recovering from illness, Ted decided to ______ the day and make the most of every chance to grow and learn.
= E
~詞義 seize（v.）把握當下(seize the day)
~原文 After recovering from illness, Ted decided to seize the day and make the most of every chance to grow and learn.
